title: 第9章 赤阳锻体诀第10章 官职
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
第三层，第四层，夏辰一本都没有放过，全都收录。
之后他来到第五层。
第五层空间广阔，但只摆放了百本功法。
夏辰依旧如法炮制，他能感觉到，不同楼层收录功法所需要的时间也不同。
比如第一层，大多两三秒便能够收录，而到第五层，则最少都需要一两分钟。
夏辰依旧耐心的等待，在这一层，他发现收藏了千人军阵功法。
可以调动全军之力，加持己身。
总共有十本，被特殊放在一个区域中。
另一个区域中摆放着佛道术法，而另一角摆放了一些儒家书法字画等，每一本字帖画卷，都蕴含了一种特殊的道韵，内蕴浩然真气。
对走儒家道路的读书人有大益处。
“铭刻！”
夏辰走到这些字画前，直接开始铭刻！
看着面板上的进度条，夏辰露出笑意。
最后，将五楼所有功法收录铭刻完之后，夏辰拿起一本名叫《赤阳锻体诀》的炼体功法开始装模作样的看了起来。
但同时，在内心中说道。
“开始推演，并进行灌输！”
【系统推演中！】
五分钟后，面板上有新的文字出现。
【《赤阳锻体诀》真意灌输中！】
【进度值：5%】

【进度值：35%】
【进度值：78%】
……
整个传输过程持续了三分钟，夏辰感觉自己的皮肤变得赤热起来，血肉骨骼仿佛在被岩浆淬炼，每一块血肉都宛如在被神匠敲打，将杂质敲出。
夏辰眸子中，有大日升起，之前领悟的首阳破魔刀真意与赤阳锻体奥义融合。
每一滴血液都变得粘稠，蕴含至阳之气！
整个五楼空间都变得赤热起来，仿佛来到了盛夏。
夏辰整个人如同一块刚刚从高温火炉中新鲜出炉的钢铁。
夏洪夏黄两位族老瞬间出现在第五层空间中，目光凝重的看着夏辰的变化。
“这是领悟了赤阳锻体决？”
“这么快就领悟了赤阳真意？”
两人同时惊呼！
眼神中皆闪过不可思议之色。
赤阳锻体诀这门功法他们是知晓的，对武夫修行有大益处，即便是对四品境，都有一定功效。
因此这才能被放在第五层藏功楼中。
整个藏功楼都是在他们两个的感知中的，原本他们看到夏辰走马观花的观看功法，便不再过多关注。
但怎么突然一下子就领悟了赤阳锻体诀呢？
两人脑门上一头问号！
夏辰缓缓睁开双眸，眼眸中的那轮大日缓缓退去，毛孔中喷薄的气血之力也缓缓收敛，皮肤不再赤红。
“四爷爷，六爷爷，你们怎么在这！”

夏辰装作好奇的问道，他自然知道，这么重要乃是整个侯府根本的藏功楼必定会有人守护。
“你怎么这么快就领悟了赤阳锻体诀？”
夏洪性子急，率先问了出来。
content_en:
On the third and fourth floors, Xia Chen didn't let go of any of them and collected them all.
Then he came to the fifth floor.
The fifth floor has a vast space, but only a hundred exercises are displayed.
Xia Chen still followed the same method, and he could feel that the time required to record the skills on different floors was also different.
For example, the first level can be collected in two or three seconds, while the fifth level can take at least one or two minutes.
Xia Chen still waited patiently. On this floor, he found a collection of Thousand-Man Army Formation Techniques.
You can mobilize the power of the entire army to bless your body.
There are ten books in total, placed in a special area.
Another area displays Buddhist and Taoist techniques, while another corner displays some Confucian calligraphy, calligraphy and paintings. Each calligraphy scroll contains a special Taoist charm and awe-inspiring true energy.
It is of great benefit to scholars who follow the Confucian path.
"Engraved!"
Xia Chen walked up to these calligraphy and paintings and started to engrave them directly!
Looking at the progress bar on the panel, Xia Chen smiled.
Finally, after collecting and inscribing all the exercises on the fifth floor, Xia Chen picked up a book called "Chiyang Body Training Technique" and started to pretend to read it.
But at the same time, he said in his heart.
"Start the deduction and indoctrination!"
[System deduction in progress! 】
Five minutes later, new text appeared on the panel.
[The true meaning of "Chi Yang Body Training Technique" is being instilled! 】
[Progress value: 5%]
[Progress value: 35%]
[Progress value: 78%]
…
The entire transmission process lasted for three minutes. Xia Chen felt that his skin became red-hot, and his flesh and bones seemed to be tempered by magma. Every piece of flesh and blood seemed to be being beaten by a divine craftsman to knock out impurities.
In Xia Chen's eyes, there was a big sun rising, and the true meaning of the Shouyang Demon-Breaking Sword that he had understood before merged with the profound meaning of Chiyang Body Forging.
Every drop of blood becomes thicker and contains the most yang energy!
The entire space on the fifth floor became red-hot, as if it was midsummer.
Xia Chen's whole body was like a piece of steel freshly baked from a high-temperature furnace.
The two clan elders, Xia Hong and Xia Huang, instantly appeared in the fifth layer of space, looking at Xia Chen's changes with solemn eyes.
"Did you understand the Chiyang Body Training Technique?"
"You realized Chiyang's true meaning so quickly?"
They both exclaimed at the same time!
There was an incredible look in their eyes.
They are aware of the Chiyang Body Forging Technique, which is of great benefit to martial arts practice, and has certain effects even on those in the fourth level.
Therefore, this can be placed in the fifth floor of the Tibetan Gong Building.
The entire Hidden Gong Tower was within the perception of the two of them. Originally, they no longer paid much attention to Xia Chen when they saw Xia Chen watching the skills.
But why did he suddenly comprehend the Chiyang Body Strengthening Technique?
There was a question mark on both of their heads!
Xia Chen slowly opened his eyes, and the bright sun in his eyes slowly receded. The force of Qi and blood spurting out of his pores also slowly converged, and his skin was no longer red.
"Fourth Grandpa, Sixth Grandpa, why are you here!"
Xia Chen asked pretending to be curious. He naturally knew that such an important building, which was the foundation of the entire Hou Mansion, would be guarded by someone.
"How come you understood the Chi Yang Body Training Technique so quickly?"
Xia Hong was impatient and asked first.
